title.narrative: Supporting Digital Skills for Next Generation

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen digital education in Zambia by piloting a hub school model in Lusaka Province. The initiative focuses on building teachers’ and learners’ digital capacity, equipping the school with modern technologies, and ensuring equitable access, especially for girls and disadvantaged groups. It will map existing digital initiatives, draw lessons from successful African models like Ghana, and generate evidence to guide national policy. Key outputs include a computer lab, smart classrooms, digital pedagogy training, and locally relevant learning content. At the national level, the project will contribute to developing a coordinated digital education strategy, ensuring that the pilot serves both as an immediate benefit for the hub school and a proof of concept for scaling up sustainable, cost-effective digital learning solutions across Zambia.
